invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null list by collecting the stream into a list, which never results in null.
The getFileId() method is expected to return non-null file ids for each file slice, so the result list should contain no null entries.
The code applies distinct() to the stream before collecting, so the resulting list contains only unique file ids.
Assuming file ids are non-empty strings, as they identify file slices.
partitionPath is used as an argument in several method calls, so it must be non-null to avoid NullPointerException.
